property_summary: For any target and value, calling sendMoney on the reference C does not change depositsCount (it only forwards funds); the mutant increments depositsCount after the external call, so for some adversarial target (one that accepts the call) depositsCount will increase in the mutant but remain unchanged in the reference.
change_summary: Insert an update to depositsCount after the call, changing observable state after sendMoney completes.
